mainRoof.notes: Main ridge along the front, with a raised centre section. Right end is gabled (two overlapping right-facing gables on the right elevation); left end is hipped down behind the garage block. Garage block has its own taller gable roof with ridge front-to-back and a gable facing the front. Decorative cross gable over the entrance (triangular window) on the front slope; decorative cross gable with three transom windows on the rear slope; rear-facing gable over the bedroom-3 wing. Lean-to porch roofs front (wrapping the right corner with a hip) and rear, drawn as standing-seam metal on the elevations.

uncertain: Entrance door sits at about 0.67 of the overall front width - on the CENTRE/RIGHT boundary; it is central on the main (non-garage) body.
Bonus-room triple window in the garage gable (FRONT storey 1) is 3 x 2'-8" = about 2.45 m wide - on the WINDOW / LARGE_GLAZING boundary; counted as one WINDOW.
Primary-bedroom triple window on the rear is about 2.3 m wide; counted as one WINDOW.

RIGHT facade: the first WINDOW and the DOOR are in the garage's right-hand side wall (set far forward-left); the door (garage to porch) is only clear on the plan, it is hidden behind a porch post on the elevation. The remaining two windows are on the right gable wall (bath single, play-room double).
FRONT: the small fixed mudroom window sits in a wall set back beside the garage under the porch roof.
The triangular front gable window and the rear transom band light a single-storey space (decorative gables), so they are listed as features, not storey-1 openings.
Left end of the main roof read as hipped from the left and rear elevations; roof pitch and building height are not stated anywhere.
